The '''Model 6 modular backpack''', also known as the '''"Mule" modular backpack''', was a model of modular [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] produced by the [[Adventure Hiker and Hunter/Legends|Adventure Hiker and Hunter]] company. Available after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the backpack cost 50 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="AORC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Model 6 modular backpack was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]].
